meta.word_rule: runs of letters in any alphabet, an inner apostrophe or hyphen kept, lowercased, a possessive 's removed; digits and punctuation dropped
meta.network: in-degree among the 303 pages (week05_text.graph()); links from outside them do not count
meta.fit: ordinary least squares of ln(words) on ln(1 + in-degree), all 303 pages
meta.residual: ln(words) minus the fitted value; exp(residual) is the page's length over the predicted length
meta.name_rule: its title without the disambiguation, plus the real name its node description gives in brackets, as a whole word
meta.hub_rule: the first paragraph says the page is "the name of" several characters
meta.heading_rule: a line under 45 characters, of at most six words, not ending in a full stop, before the reference sections

outliers.name: Brian Braddock
outliers.reason: The link network undercounts him. His codename, Captain Britain, is on 14 other pages (since 2020 it is also Betsy Braddock's), but only 1 of them links to his page. If all of them linked, the line would put him at ×1.9 predicted instead of ×8.0.

quote.text: For a time he fought crime on his own, serving as a hero for the common man as opposed to the aristocratic Captain Britain.

outliers.name: Miracleman (character)
outliers.reason: An isolate: no link in or out, and no other page names him. He began as a British character whom Marvel licensed in 2010, and his 15 headings follow his publication history from 1954 on.

quote.text: Marvel licensed the characters from Anglo directly and in 2010 began a series of reprints of classic material under the Marvelman name.

outliers.name: Betsy Braddock
outliers.reason: Not undercounted: 7 pages link to her, more than the 3 that name Betsy Braddock. Her page has 48 headings because it tells two careers, as Psylocke and as Captain Britain.

quote.text: Following nearly 30 years of publication history, both women were returned to their original bodies, and Betsy took up the mantle of Captain Britain from her brother while Kwannon became the new Psylocke.

outliers.name: U.S. Agent
outliers.reason: Named on 8 other pages, 3 of them without a link. Counting those as links only moves him from ×4.3 to ×3.3 predicted: the length is in his 40 headings, from his first stories to the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

quote.text: His actions earn him the respect of U.S. Agent.

outliers.name: Isaiah Bradley
outliers.reason: No page links to him, and only 1 other page names him. His page is long because it covers the 2003 series Truth: Red, White & Black and what critics wrote about it.

quote.text: Sharon Packer, in her 2010 book Superheroes and Superegos: Analyzing the Minds Behind the Masks, wrote that the events and characters of Truth: Red, White & Black convey important messages about race relations, conspiracy theories, and performance enhancement in sports.

outliers.name: Quasar (character)
outliers.reason: A page for a shared codename: four characters have been Quasar, each with one section here, and 24 pages link to the name.

quote.text: Quasar is the name of several superheroes appearing in American comic books published by Marvel Comics.

outliers.name: Blue Bullet
outliers.reason: Both pages that link to him mention the Invaders, the wartime team he fought, and his own page has 3 headings: it lists three issues, and he dies in the third.

quote.text: The character subsequently appears in The Invaders #4 (August 1993), in which he dies.

outliers.name: Ch'od
outliers.reason: All 4 pages that link to him mention the Starjammers, his crew: he gets links as a team member, and his page has 5 headings.

quote.text: met and formed the band of smugglers and space pirates known as the Starjammers; with Corsair, Hepzibah, and Ch'od, and associated himself with the group.

outliers.name: Lei Kung (character)
outliers.reason: All 3 pages that link to him mention K'un-Lun, Iron Fist's city: he is known as Iron Fist's teacher, and his own page has 4 headings.

quote.text: Yü-Ti apprentices him to Lei Kung the Thunderer, who teaches him martial arts.

outliers.name: Toxyn
outliers.reason: All 3 pages that link to her mention the Morituri, her team, and she was in that one series until her death; her page has 4 headings.

quote.text: She was a regular cast member until her death in issue #21.
